lines: The best temperature for a bedroom at night is about 18°C.
Many people are surprised by this because 18°C can feel a little too cold.
However, this temperature helps most people sleep well if they use normal blankets and clothes.
Of course, the perfect temperature is not the same for everyone.
Each person is different, depending on their age, gender, and what they like.
Still, 18°C is good for most people.
Most people keep their bedrooms warmer than they should.
This can lead to lower sleep quality and shorter sleep time.
If a room is colder than 13°C, it can be harmful to your sleep without warm blankets or clothes.
However, most of us are in the opposite group and make our bedrooms too warm — around 21 or 22°C.
Doctors often ask patients who can’t sleep at night about their bedroom temperature.
Then they advise the patients to lower the temperature by about 2 to 4°C.
If you don’t believe that temperature affects sleep, consider this experiment.
As scientists gently warmed the feet or bodies of mice, the mice released heat and their inner body temperature went down.
As a result, they fell asleep much faster than usual.
